primary_endpoint: Final-layer orbit-centered generator and unfitted-composition prediction errors, with trained versus matched random initialization; both landmarks reported.
primary_scope: Prospective structural assay of previously trained ordinary models; fresh complete orbits withheld from all recorded source/target data. No new architecture or equivariance training.
field_scope: C4 rotations, D4 rotations/reflections, and irreversible idempotent projection on F5^4; probe-held-out inputs only, because source models previously saw all 625 inputs.
interpretation: Fit generators independently. No group laws or projection idempotence enforced during fitting. Orbit residuals remove invariant energy. Consistency alone is insufficient without held-out prediction and controls. Repeats are source seeds/worlds, not activation rows or action pairs.
